findings.reason: Retaining only the latest reply witness can indefinitely suppress a legitimate push for an earlier queued public reply when a private reply follows, and the spec gives no capacity or privacy evidence that rules out intelligently retaining another represented witness within a bounded store and rechecking its permission at send time.

findings.standard: An Instar Agent Is Always a Multi-Machine Entity
findings.reason: The design lets a disconnected holder send a push using a stale unmuted value, although the Pending exception requires an unreachable member to catch up before serving a current view and limits local-only state to information with no effect yet on the shared record.

fit.reason: The spec supports plain-language confirmations and reversible archive, but its core design governs preference storage and notification delivery while leaving action placement, visual hierarchy, and phone usability to the app.
